Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Queens for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events. The weekend of December 6 is the big one, with a free Holiday Festival and Tree Lighting Celebration at Astoria Park, a Family Holiday Celebration at The Castle in Fort Totten and St. Nicholas Day at the Vander Ende-Onderdonk House in Ridgewood, alongside Winter Wonder at Queens Botanical Garden, the Winter Lantern Festival at Queens County Farm Museum and Joy on the Farm. We check every date on the host's own website or the city's official listing, and each card links straight there.

What Rally found in Queens

  • 6 Christmas events for kids in Queens

  • Meet Santa and make crafts: The Castle in Fort Totten and the Vander Ende-Onderdonk House (both December 6)
